notes: Dark mode now uses true black on AMOLED screens, so the background switches off and the pet and cards stand out more.

history.notes: A small paw shows while the 3D pet loads, and long habit and pet names wrap on pet cards instead of being cut off.

Husky dogs now come in grey, black or red coats, with a white chest and face.
